steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize app metadata, configure backend API schema, and outline package structure.

steps.title: Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper standard SDK versioning and standard dependencies.

steps.title: Manifest Setup
steps.description: Declare permissions, core Activities, and custom launch settings in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: UI Design Resources
steps.description: Create reusable shape and color drawables for rounded input containers, alerts, and clean action buttons.

steps.title: Backend API Integration
steps.description: Write a pure-Java HTTP helper class (BackendApi.java) to handle register, login, OTP recovery, and /data operations with manual JSON processing.

steps.title: Local Cache Engine
steps.description: Develop a lightweight SharedPreferences-backed data store to serve as an offline-first cache when there's no network.

steps.title: Product and Sale Models
steps.description: Create standard Java data-transfer objects for Products and Sales, enabling precise offline business calculations.

steps.title: Authentication Screens UI
steps.description: Design visual layout for login, user signup registration, and Gmail-based OTP password recovery screens.

steps.title: Authentication Controller Logic
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity logic matching all rules for authentication, token handling, registration response structures, and OTP generation.

steps.title: Dashboard Design
steps.description: Design an analytical MainActivity dashboard with summary boxes (Valuation, Total Stock, Low Warnings) and dynamic sync feedback.

steps.title: Dashboard Controller Logic
steps.description: Implement MainActivity functionality to auto-load products, run dynamic calculations locally, and refresh UI fields seamlessly.

steps.title: Inventory Management UI
steps.description: Design the layout to view all products, search, and switch to category-wise stock filters.

steps.title: Inventory Controller and List Adapter
steps.description: Code InventoryActivity and custom Adapter to manage filters, launch product creations, and manage low-stock colors.

steps.title: Product Details Form & Margin Calculator
steps.description: Implement product addition and editing interface with live dynamic margin percentage updating on pricing entry.

steps.title: POS Quick Billing Counter
steps.description: Develop high-speed cashier checkout checkout ledger interface, supporting custom sales basket collections, automated revenue calculation, and instant local stock quantity deduction.

steps.title: Sales Ledger History UI and Logic
steps.description: Integrate previous transaction log visualization (SalesHistoryActivity) with list-view display of past earnings.

steps.title: Building Shop Inventory & Stock Sync
steps.description: Perform full debug builds using Gradle compilation to ensure error-free assembly without resource linkage or syntax issues.
